note: _non in fossis inveni eos, sed in omnibus quae supra memoravi –_ not in ditches have I found them, but in all places (_omnibus_ = _omnibus locis_) which I mentioned before (Douay Version). The last part of the sentence – _quae supra memoravi_ – has no basis in the Hebrew; this is the translator’s explanatory gloss. The Nova Vulgata revises the sentence and omits the explanatory gloss.
